description: This file defines the SurveysDashlet class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to provide a custom dashboard widget for Surveys within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes setup for dashlet metadata, title, search fields, columns, and the seed bean for Surveys.

classes.name: SurveysDashlet
classes.description: A class representing a custom dashlet for displaying Surveys in SuiteCRM, extending the DashletGeneric base class.
